documents.title: Nested Loop Brute Force Search
documents.pattern_description: Comparing every pair of elements using nested iterations resulting in O(n²) quadratic runtime.
documents.recommendation: Check if a Hash Map (O(n) time, O(n) space) or Two-Pointer technique on a sorted array can reduce complexity from O(n²) to O(n) or O(n log n).

documents.title: Two Pointers Technique
documents.pattern_description: Using two pointers (left and right or fast and slow) to iterate through a sequence in linear time.
documents.recommendation: Ensure pointer increments and decrements cannot cross each other infinitely or cause off-by-one errors.

documents.title: Binary Search Pattern
documents.pattern_description: Repeatedly dividing a sorted search space in half to achieve logarithmic runtime search O(log n).
key_edge_cases: integer overflow in mid calculation (low + (high - low) / 2)
documents.recommendation: Use `mid = low + (high - low) / 2` to prevent potential integer overflow in languages like C++ and Java.

documents.title: Sliding Window Pattern
documents.pattern_description: Maintaining a dynamic window over array/string contiguous subarrays to compute running aggregates.
key_edge_cases: window size larger than input length
documents.recommendation: Shrink window left boundary while window constraints are violated before expanding right boundary.

documents.title: Hash Map Lookups & Frequency Counting
documents.pattern_description: Using a hash table or dictionary for O(1) average time lookups, duplicate detection, and frequency count.
documents.recommendation: Always verify key existence before accessing map values to prevent runtime KeyErrors or default insertions.

documents.title: C++ Vector Pass-by-Reference & Range Loops
documents.pattern_description: Best practice rules for passing C++ std::vector objects and modern range iteration.
documents.rule: Pass vectors by const reference `const std::vector<int>&` to prevent expensive linear deep copy allocations.
documents.recommendation: Use `const auto&` in range-based loops `for(const auto& item : vec)` when reading elements without mutating.

documents.title: C++ Signed Integer Overflow Safety
documents.pattern_description: Preventing undefined behavior when performing arithmetic on 32-bit signed integers.
documents.rule: Signed integer overflow in C++ causes Undefined Behavior (UB). Use `long long` for large accumulations.
documents.recommendation: Check bound limits before adding or multiplying large integer variables.

documents.title: Pythonic Iteration & List Comprehensions
documents.pattern_description: Leveraging Python built-in iterators, enumerate, and generators for cleaner execution.
documents.rule: Avoid `for i in range(len(lst))` when element values are needed directly. Use `for item in lst:` or `for i, item in enumerate(lst):`.
documents.recommendation: Replace simple element transformation loops with list comprehensions or generator expressions for speed and readability.

documents.title: JavaScript Strict Equality & Const/Let Variable Scope
documents.pattern_description: Avoiding coercion bugs and implicit globals in JS scripts.
documents.rule: Use strict equality `===` instead of `==` to avoid automatic type coercion bugs.
documents.recommendation: Provide a explicit compare function `(a, b) => a - b` to `Array.prototype.sort()` to prevent lexicographical sorting on numbers.

documents.title: Java Object Equality & Collection Bounds
documents.pattern_description: Proper usage of `.equals()` vs `==` and array indexing safety in Java.
documents.rule: Compare Objects and Strings using `.equals()` rather than `==` which compares memory references.
documents.recommendation: Prefer `ArrayList` or `List` interfaces over raw arrays when dynamic resizing or utility methods are needed.

documents.title: Off-by-One Loop Bounds
documents.pattern_description: Iterating up to `<= array.length` or setting incorrect array termination bounds leading to Out-Of-Bounds exceptions.
documents.rule: 0-indexed arrays run from `0` to `length - 1`. Iterating to `<= length` reads outside valid memory allocated for the container.
documents.recommendation: Use strict inequality `< length` or range-based loops to eliminate boundary indexing errors.

documents.title: Unbounded / Unchecked Mutation Inside Loops
documents.pattern_description: Modifying loop index counters manually inside `for` loops or altering collection structure while iterating.
documents.rule: Mutating loop index state in multiple places leads to skipped elements, infinite execution loops, or ConcurrentModificationExceptions.
documents.recommendation: Decouple iteration logic from state mutation or create a filtered copy of the array.

documents.title: Missing Base Case in Recursion
documents.pattern_description: Recursive function calls without strict terminating condition resulting in Stack Overflow.
documents.rule: Every recursive call path must converge towards a base case that returns without making further self-invocations.
documents.recommendation: Validate base conditions (`n <= 0`, empty tree node, etc.) at the very top of recursive functions.

documents.title: Unchecked Null / Pointer / Empty Access
documents.pattern_description: Dereferencing pointers or accessing index 0 of empty arrays without checking size first.
documents.rule: Calling properties or elements on null/empty data structures causes runtime crashes (NullPointerException, Segmentation Fault).
documents.recommendation: Add explicit initial size or null check `if (vec.empty()) return 0;` at start of routine.
